First Breakfast Omelette

  • 2 eggs
  • 1 tbsp milk
  • 1 tsp butter
  • 1 pinch salt
  1. Beat eggs with milk and salt.
  2. Melt butter in a pan and pour in eggs.
  3. Cook the omelette until softly set.

Second Berry Toast

  • 2 slices bread
  • 50 g cream cheese
  • 80 g berries
  1. Toast bread and spread cream cheese.
  2. Add berries on top and serve.
